/**
 * Points the camera at the given mode's limits and snaps the current
 * pose inside that mode's zoom (radius) and heading (yaw) ranges.
 *
 * Assigning `camera.limits` defers taking effect until the next
 * yaw/pitch/radius write that changes a value, or a center assignment,
 * so we do both: write clamped radius/yaw (which also adopts the
 * limits), and re-assign the center to force adoption even when the
 * pose is already in range.
 */
export function useModeLimits(camera: GeospatialCamera, limits: GeospatialLimits): void {
  camera.limits = limits;

  camera.radius = clamp(camera.radius, limits.radiusMin, limits.radiusMax);
  camera.yaw = clamp(camera.yaw, limits.yawMin, limits.yawMax);

  // Force the new limits to be applied even if the pose was already in range
  // (in which case the writes above did not change a value).
  camera.center = camera.center;
}

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number): number {
